title: Synthesize placeholder tool on turns with tool history and no tools (later reverted in #1031)
answer_key: Defining a synthetic placeholder tool when an agent has tool history but no active tools diverges from the reference wire behavior and broke callers, requiring revert in PR #1031.

title: Stamp memory version redacted_at with now() instead of clock_timestamp() after lock (#989)
answer_key: Using now() instead of clock_timestamp() after acquiring the store lock stamps redacted_at with transaction start time rather than post-lock time, breaking ordering under contention.

title: Docker file write breaks on long paths containing single quotes (#862)
answer_key: Expanding quote-heavy paths before checking command or filename length limits breaks or truncates Docker writes on long paths with single quotes.

title: Share sandbox write temporary path validation across backends
Validate changelog fragment links before release
Pagination cursor not bound to issuing list (#1004)
answer_key: Omitting list-scoped cursor binding allows a page token minted by one list route to be replayed against a different list endpoint instead of returning 400 invalid_request_error.

title: Egress gate fails to re-check policy at outbound admission or sever withdrawn connections
answer_key: Without re-checking the live policy snapshot at outbound admission and severing active tunnels/requests upon withdrawal, a revoked host or credential stays usable after policy update.

title: Unicode hostnames folded instead of refused in allowed_hosts and MCP URLs (#614)
answer_key: Accepting or punycode-folding non-ASCII Unicode hostnames in allowed_hosts or MCP server URLs diverges from the reference refusal and risks host-matching surprises.

title: Report release and development versions in browser sessions
Fix changelog link rewriting and release boundaries
